Scratching a correction into wax-tablet margins while a self-writing quill fills the column beside her with tiny annotated counter-glyphs that pulse faint teal each time one fully sets.
Seated with both hands wrapped around a warm mug, watching a chalk-rune across the room on the hearthstone pulse a slow deep-red in steady rhythm with the settling of the coals.

Murmuring a low incantation with both palms held face-up above an open casting-circle, pale-indigo light gathering at the center of each hand and stretching toward the other like two halves of a slow breath.
Cradling a sleeping wisp-fox against her collarbone with one arm while turning pages of a battered fieldbook with the other hand, the creature's fur pulsing a slow dreaming gold with every breath.

Knotting the final loop of a silver binding-cord stretched between two iron bench-clamps, a small bright-white spark releasing at the knot's completion and drifting straight upward before winking out.
Stirring a copper cauldron with a long-handled bone spoon as jade-green vapor spirals upward and folds back into the simmering brew.
Tracing a chalk-rune onto the hearthstone slab with two fingers, a thin line of crimson light bleeding up where the symbol closes itself.
Cross-legged on the hearthrug with a heavy grimoire propped open across both knees, a small amber wisp-orb hovering just above the page illuminating the cramped silver script.
